question: 感觉他这两年盘子缩了不少，往回看，2024年末的时候他的在管总规模是多少？
answer:
[1] 关键金融指标  
在管总规模（AUM，Assets Under Management）

[2] 可能的计算公式  
在管总规模 = 期初在管总规模 + 本期净流入资金 + 投资收益 - 本期净赎回资金
['在管总规模', 'AUM', 'Assets Under Management', '期初在管总规模', '本期净流入资金', '投资收益', '本期净赎回资金']

生成查询代码
SELECT 
    i.TRADING_DAY AS `时间`,
    i.INDEX_ABBR AS `指数名称`,
    i.INDEX_CODE AS `指数代码`,
    ROUND(i.TOTAL_MARKET_VALUE/100000000, 1) AS `总市值(亿)`,
    ROUND(i.FLOAT_MARKET_VALUE/100000000, 1) AS `流通市值(亿)`,
    ROUND(i.CLOSE_PRICE, 2) AS `收盘价`,
    ROUND(i.HIGH_PRICE, 2) AS `最高价`,
    ROUND(i.LOW_PRICE, 2) AS `最低价`,
    ROUND(i.OPEN_PRICE, 2) AS `开盘价`,
    ROUND(i.PE1,2) AS `市盈率PE`,
    ROUND(i.PB,2) AS `市净率PB`,
    ROUND(i.DY_RATIO1,2) AS `股息率(%)`
FROM INDEX_QUOTE_ALL i
WHERE i.INDEX_ABBR LIKE '%资产管理%'
  AND i.TRADING_DAY = '2024-12-31'
  AND i.TOTAL_MARKET_VALUE IS NOT NULL
  AND i.HISVALID=1
ORDER BY i.TOTAL_MARKET_VALUE DESC
